exposure: Oxytocin (3 IU IV bolus, followed by 2 IU after 3 minutes)
Oxytocin (1 IU/min continuous infusion over 5 minutes)
cohort: A total of 92 patients undergoing elective Lower Segment Caesarean Section (LSCS) under spinal anesthesia were included.
finding: Both bolus and infusion oxytocin regimens are effective in preventing PPH, with the bolus method being preferable for rapid uterine contraction and reduced intraoperative blood loss, while the infusion method provides a gradual and sustained uterotonic effect but requires closer hemodynamic monitoring.
